mentions.name: Pasclaw
mentions.description: An AI agent built in native Object Pascal for the Free Pascal Compiler and Delphi, running in less than 10MB of RAM. It is Windows-forward and local-first, with experiments including incorporating WebLLM and running the agent in the browser inside a WASM Linux environment.
mentions.source_excerpt: Orchestrating an AI agent built in native Object Pascal for Free Pascal Compiler and Delphi. Runs in less than 10MB of RAM. Besides being very Windows forward and local first; doing some fun things with it like incorporating WebLLM and running it in the browser inside a WASM Linux.
mentions.author: fmxexpress
